acceptanceCriteria: A spec defines the closed question set, the packet shape, the tree-hash key and invalidation, with requirement IDs.
A frozen evaluation compares standing-answer packets with on-demand packets for byte cost and evidence parity at the same revision.
Read commands serve a standing answer only when its key matches the bound tree; otherwise they fall back to on-demand compilation.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 from a review of vectorize-io/hindsight (MIT agent-memory system; README reviewed via summary, paper arXiv 2512.12818 and code not read). Hindsight's 'mental models' are standing answers to predefined questions, rewritten as data arrives and served without retrieval latency. Corvint analog: a closed set of recurring questions (e.g. how to test a path, what governs a path) answered by deterministic packets built at `index --if-stale` time as derived state keyed to the tree hash, never rewritten by an LLM and never outranking live evidence. Relates to V1-0023 (compact evidence summaries).
title: index: precompute deterministic standing-answer packets for recurring task questions, keyed to the tree hash
